cards.description: Campers practice mountain bike skills on trails and skills features, with bike games and off-bike activities. Coaches assess equipment and riding skills and divide riders into groups by ability.

cards.name: Gravity Camp at Beech Mountain Bike Park
cards.description: Riders practice downhill park and gravity racing skills on chairlift-access trails. The camp focuses on technique and progression on jumps, flow trails, and technical terrain.

hours.text: Camp runs 9:30am-3:30pm each day. DropOff is from 9-9:30am and PickUp is from 3:30-4pm.
